function.name: ClassFactory_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IClassFactory. If it matches, the function sets the ppv pointer to the iface pointer and returns S_OK. If it doesn't match, the function sets the ppv pointer to NULL and returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer on successful return

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported, and E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: ClassFactory_AddRef
function.description: This function returns a static value of 2

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IClassFactory

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a static value of 2

function.name: ClassFactory_Release
function.description: This function releases the class factory interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the class factory to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the operation, in this case it always returns 1 indicating success.

function.name: ClassFactory_LockServer
function.description: This function locks or unlocks the class factory server based on the boolean value passed to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the class factory.

parameters.name: fLock
parameters.description: This boolean value determines whether to lock (if TRUE) or unlock (if FALSE) the server.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. S_OK is returned if the operation is successful.

function.name: DllGetClassObject
function.description: This function retrieves a class object from a DLL object and provides the ability to create an object of a specified class.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: The CLSID that will be associated with the data and code that will be used to create the object.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: A reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the object.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: The address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. Upon failure, *ppv contains NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: Ole32DllGetClassObject
function.description: This function checks the class ID of the provided object and returns the corresponding interface, if available.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: The class ID of the object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The interface ID to be queried.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: A pointer to the interface pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns specific values for different class IDs and CLASS_E_CLASSNOTAVAILABLE if the class ID does not match any predefined IDs.
